title: DuckExporter lacks interface seam
evidence: Autoresearch blocked multiple flusher scenarios because DuckExporter is a concrete type without an interface seam.
suggested_fix: Extract a narrow exporter interface for executeFlush/executeBatch so flush paths can be tested without production behavior changes.

title: AcquireSchemaLock depends on pg_try_advisory_lock
evidence: Flusher scenarios that pass through processSchema are blocked in local DuckDB-driven tests because pg_try_advisory_lock is unavailable.
suggested_fix: Abstract advisory lock acquisition behind an injectable seam or provide a test-friendly lock strategy.

title: DuckDB streaming path depends on concrete sql.DB and sql.Rows
evidence: Autoresearch discarded row scan / rows.Err / rowHandler scenarios because the DuckDB client and row stream are concrete *sql.DB/*sql.Rows with no seam.
suggested_fix: Introduce a narrow query/rows abstraction for streamDuckDBRows and StreamDuckDBFederatedQuery.

title: Pre-existing row handler streaming test fixture is broken
evidence: Autoresearch observed TestStreamOptimizedQuery_PropagatesRowHandlerError already failed before new candidate changes with a column/value mismatch panic. GitHub: #19 https://github.com/Lychee-Technology/forma/issues/19
suggested_fix: Repair the fixture row shape so it matches entityMainColumnDescriptors and streaming scan expectations.

title: Runs can end without a decision artifact
evidence: Autoresearch has recorded no_decision_file outcomes when the agent exits before writing the required decision artifact.
suggested_fix: Harden prompt compliance and add controller-side fallback capture for interrupted or permission-blocked runs.

title: Autoresearch run produced no decision artifact
suggested_fix: Tighten prompt compliance or add controller-side fallback capture for interrupted runs

title: Go text/template does not support testing rendering failures without custom functions
evidence: text/template.Execute does not return error for undefined fields; only custom functions that return errors can trigger rendering failure
suggested_fix: Consider adding an error-returning template function (like "must_ident" or "validate") that tests could use to trigger rendering failures, or document that this scenario cannot be tested at the unit level

title: Scenario 3 blocked - FetchDirtyRowIDs cannot be mocked
evidence: FetchDirtyRowIDs is a concrete method on DBPersistentRecordRepository, not an interface method; cannot inject error for dirty-id fetching failure test. GitHub: #17 https://github.com/Lychee-Technology/forma/issues/17
suggested_fix: Extract FetchDirtyRowIDs into an interface (e.g., DirtyIDFetcher) on the repository to enable test mocking

title: StreamDuckDBFederatedQuery hardcodes AdvancedQueryTemplateDuckDB preventing test without postgres_scan
suggested_fix: Extract query building into injectable interface or make AdvancedQueryTemplateDuckDB configurable via option
